title: Airport lounge access
summary: Covers airport lounge access using an eligible card: you receive up to 6 complimentary lounge visits per year. To use a visit, present the card and a valid ID at participating lounges; visits are deducted at entry. Includes guidance on checking participating locations, carrying the card, and guest access rules.
faqs: How many complimentary airport lounge visits per year do I get?
What do I need to show to enter a participating airport lounge?
When are my lounge visits deducted from my annual allotment?
Do I need to check which lounges participate before traveling?
Can I use digital proof instead of my card at the lounge?
Do guests have separate admission or additional visits based on lounge policies?
